newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Caracas stocks soar, ending at 4th record high.
newsitem.headline: Caracas stocks soar, ending at 4th record high.

text.p: Caracas stocks roared ahead on strong foreign bids to a fourth straight record close as investors continued to cheer last week's approval of a $14 billion ground-breaking labor reform, traders said.
"I thought it might be a slow day due to tomorrow's market holiday, but it surged on foreign buying," Financorp broker Miguel Ortiz said.

The bolsa's 19-share index closed ahead 2.23 percent at 8,187.82 points as 114 million shares exchanged hands worth 12 billion bolivars ($25 million), according to preliminary figures from the exchange.
Activalores broker Gonzalo Alonso said investor interest had been piqued by the prospect of fully funded pension funds, due to be set up under the labor reform, boosting the market.
"It was fierce today, with a lot of activity in Electricidad de Caracas," he said. The stock closed up 2.22 percent at 621.50 bolivars as over eight million shares traded.

Among traded stocks, 29 rose, and 13 fell. "I'm pretty sure the rally is here to stay," said Ortiz. Merinvest's composite MRCP index, which includes telephone company CANTV, meanwhile closed up 3.21 percent at 127.82 points.
